content.title: Rapport Therapeutics expects cash to fund requirements through 2026
content.summary: The Company ended the third quarter with $320.7 million in cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments, compared to $336.1 million as of June 30, 2024. The decrease was primarily due to cash outflows on operating activities in the third quarter of 2024. The Company expects that current cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments as of September 30, 2024, will enable the Company to fund its operating expenses and capital expenditure requirements through the end of 2026.
